source_en: be all that bad.
ar: فلا يمكن أن تكون سيئًا إلى هذا الحد.

source_en: They sendin’ Nephilim to evict us now?
Heh. I ain’t scared of you.
I’m fine!
I’m perfectly—perfectly operational.
Y'know this party's been go on for quite some time.
ar: أتعلم، هذا الحفلُ مستمرٌ منذ فترةٍ طويلة.

source_en: I hardly 'member being sober...
ar: لا أكادُ أتذكرُ حين كنتُ صاحياً…

source_en: am I stuck like this?
Truth is...
I stopped drinkin’ a bit earlier, just to test it.
ar: توقفت عن الشرب قبل قليل، فقط لأختبر الأمر.

source_en: That’s when the walls started breathin’.
I'd ask ya to fetch me some ale, but I don't seem to run out.
ar: كنتُ سأطلبُ منك إحضارَ بعضِ الجعة، لكن يبدو أنها لا تنفد. لا بد أني خزنتُ الكثير.

source_en: Must'ave stocked up quite a bit. Hahaha!
Oi—oi—there y’are...
bartender!
Took ya long enough,
I’m runnin’ dry over ‘ere.
Oh,
the whale is a fish with really big nose and he
ar: الحوتُ سمكةٌ بأنفٍ كبيرٍ جداً، يأكلُ كلَّ الجواربِ ويرتدي كلَّ الملابس.

source_en: eats all the socks and he wears all the clothes. (hiccup)
They can send the Divine himself!
This is MY property
and I’ll be damned before!
All this time I thought I was hidin’ in here...
ar: طوال هذا الوقت وأنا أحسبني مختبئة هنا…

source_en: I’m wonderin’ now if this door’s the only thing
ar: وأتساءل الآن: أيكون هذا الباب وحده ما

source_en: still rememberin’ me.
I ain't breathin',
am I?
No ache in my knee.
No hunger neither.
Just this door.
And you knock'n on't.
Been wait'n for the right time ta run.
Think I might've missed it.
This bloody mess?
Started with them Flower Folk.
Bunch o’ daft mystics pushin’ their luck
till they pissed off the cloth proper.
Next thing you know,
the church comes stormin' in shouting, "heresy!",
and draggin' folk out of their homes.
Just when it couldn’t get worse,
that bloody tower twisted itself sideways,
and the whole city went mad.
Funny thing about fear...
you think it keeps you alive...
But what if it just keeps you here?
ar: فماذا لو كان يبقيك هنا فحسب؟

source_en: Don’t suppose you’ve seen a woman bolt from this door already,
ar: لا أظنك رأيت امرأة تندفع خارجة من هذا الباب،

source_en: have you?
Feels like I remember runnin’...
but I’m still standin’ right here.
Funny thing...
I was just about to make my break,
same as before.
Feels like I've been sayin' that for hours now.
ar: يخيّل إليّ أني أردد هذا منذ ساعات.

source_en: Nephilim,
you see any more beasts out there...
give 'em a nice fine poke...
For me.
Well go on then!
Go stab some o' them beasts with that fancy sword
ar: اطعن بعض تلك الوحوش بسيفك الفاخر هذا،

source_en: of yours and distract 'em so I can get outta here.
ar: واشغلها عني حتى أفرّ من هنا.

source_en: The road you came through still clear then?
ar: أما زال الطريق الذي جئت منه خاليًا؟

source_en: Good.
Once I catch my breath I’m makin’ a run for it.
ar: ما إن ألتقط أنفاسي حتى أنطلق.

source_en: No sense dyin’ in a street that keeps movin’ under your feet.
ar: لا معنى للموت في شارع لا يكفّ عن التحرك تحت قدميك.

source_en: You there... over 'ere.
Hmm, lemme' get a closer look at'ya.
I keep thinkin’ I’ll make a dash for it...
ar: أظلّ أقول لنفسي إني سأنطلق راكضة…

source_en: but I never do.
Whole city went mad, did'n it?
ar: المدينة بأكملها جن جنونها، أليس كذلك؟

source_en: I think I went with it.
Well I'll be.
You're one them Nephilim from the stories,
ar: أنت من النيفيليم الذين في القصص،

source_en: ain't yeah?
We're all slaves ta somethin', aren't we?
A proper proposal deserves a proper jewel.
Something radiant...
something the whole court would whisper about.
Ah... you've returned.
And that glimmer in your hand...
surely that must be the ring?
I thought you magnificent...
a visionary...
the darling of the entire city.
And yet you present me with a peasant’s band?
Keep your miserable proposal!
Take your wretched seal as well.
I stole it from you at the gala when you weren't looking!
ar: سرقتُه منك في الحفل حين غفلتَ!

source_en: The great Solomon...
undone by his own admirers.
I knew you would return to the Academy.
ar: كنتُ أعلم أنك ستعود إلى الأكاديمية.

source_en: I told them all you would.
They laughed of course...
but they always did envy my instincts.
If you mean to ask for my hand, Solomon,
then let us not be vulgar about it.
Bring me a ring worthy of the man who captivated
an entire city.
ar: أحضر لي خاتمًا يليق بالرجل الذي سحر مدينةً بأسرها.

source_en: Go on then, Solomon.
Do try not to embarrass yourself.
I’ve endured this dreadful garden long enough, my love.
ar: لقد تحملتُ هذا البستان البشع بما يكفي يا حبيبي.

source_en: I refuse to let these vulgar vines claim me
ar: أرفض أن تبتلعني هذه الكروم الدنيئة قبل أن تطلب

source_en: before you’ve asked properly.
Oh, yes! This is just how I imagined it!
ar: آه، نعم! هذا بالضبط ما تخيلته! مهلًا.

source_en: Wait.
No!
ar: لا يمكن أن يكون هذا جادًّا.

source_en: This cannot be serious.
ar: الرجل الذي وعد بإعادة بناء قيلدنارك…

source_en: The man who promised to rebuild Gildenarch...
offering this... trinket?!
Oh! My dear lord,
you did come back for me after all.
ar: عدتَ من أجلي بعد كل شيء.

source_en: Ahhh... there you are again.
I wondered when you'd come back to... eh...
ar: كنت أتساءل متى تعود لـ… إيه…

source_en: knock.
And now so do I.
Hinges,
boards,
beams...
I feel them all when you press your hand there.
ar: أحسّها كلها حين تضغط بيدك هناك.

source_en: Best not try the handle though.
The hinges and I have an understanding.
But the house and I sorted it out.
We share the rooms now.
Very civil arrangement.
Oh! Back again are ya?
Careful with that knock—the frame feels it these days.
ar: رفقًا بالطرق—فالإطار يحسّ به هذه الأيام.

source_en: Strange thing about doors...
they remember every touch.
Every visitor.
Every little knock.
Funniest thing...
When you knock like that,
ar: حين تطرق هكذا، أحسّ بالرجفة تسري في الخشب.

source_en: I feel it run right through the wood.
Haha, tickles a bit. Hahaha!
Go on then...
give it a PROPER knock.
No need to be shy with me now.
Ohhh, there you are again.
Go on then—give the door a knock.
We both enjoy it.
Hmm... Yes, right there.
Oh, the hinges feel that one all the way through the frame.
ar: آه، المفاصل تحسّ بتلك عبر الإطار كله.

source_en: House has been restless lately.
Walls creakin',
floors breathin'.
You know how homes get
when the weather turns strange.
So, ah, do come knock again someday, dear.
ar: إذن، آه، تعال واطرق مجددًا يومًا ما، يا عزيزي.

source_en: I'll always know when you're at the door.
ar: سأعرف دائمًا حين تكون عند الباب.

source_en: Yes, yes, I hear you tappin'.
Polite of you, that is.
Most folk just bang like savages, hahaha!
Oh, ho ho ho—mind the knock there, darlin'. Haha!
ar: آه، هو هو هو—رفقًا بالطرق يا عزيزي.

source_en: The door's in a sensitive mood today.
ar: هاها! الباب في مزاج حسّاس اليوم.

source_en: Started in the cellar, you see.
Roots slippin' through the stone
like curious fingers.
ar: الجذور تتسلل عبر الحجر كأصابع فضولية.

source_en: Strange thing about doors, dear...
ar: أمر غريب في الأبواب يا عزيزي…

source_en: the more you knock,
the more they open up to you.
Funny 'nuff they don't discriminate against
ar: والمضحك أنهم لا يفرقون بين حيّ وميت.

source_en: whether or not they're live or dead.
A body's a body to 'em.
I see 'em passin' every night
with some hapless fool kickin' and screamin'
Ye daft mate?
Them horned knackers been draggin' folk off
ar: يا صاح؟ أوغاد القرون هؤلاء يجرّون

source_en: and takin' 'em off to god knows where.
ar: الناس ويسوقونهم إلى حيث لا يعلم أحد.

source_en: What did the Divine get in return?
A weak flock,
those who could not stay the sin of this world.
ar: عجز عن كبح خطيئة هذا العالم.

source_en: Perhaps he was wrong.
Perhaps everything I believed was wrong.
ar: ولعل كل ما آمنتُ به كان خطأ.

source_en: Achieve great gnosis,
and return to me once you've learned the faith's
ar: العليا، وعُد إليّ متى علمتَ أشدّ

source_en: most tightly guarded secret.
I heard the commotion.
Mathias was slain.
After your fight I searched the hall for him,
ar: بحثتُ عنه في القاعة بعد قتالك،

source_en: only to find myself on the receiving end of his jaws.
Thus my suspicions were finally confirmed.
My my child.
You are delightfully... sinful.
Bearer of the sins of your progenitors.
I'm no fool Nephilim.
Those of us left in this city are damned.
ar: من بقي في هذه المدينة فهو ملعون.

source_en: Beyond the Spire is Purgatory,
and it bleeds into our world.
Congratulations are in order.
You've obtained the knowledge of your holy guardian angel.
ar: بلغتَ معرفة ملاكك الحارس المقدس. لستَ ساقطًا ولا ملعونًا،

source_en: You are not fallen, nor cursed, but blessed.
You are the next stage of humanity.
Perhaps our guardians.
Gain more strength.
Heal the scar in your soul that has existed since your birth.
ar: داوِ الندبة في روحك التي وُجدت منذ ولادتك.

source_en: Obtain holy revelation.
I must confess.
I am resentful of my time wasted among the cloth.
ar: من اعتراف. تعتريني المرارة على عمري الضائع بين

source_en: Many were corrupt.
Perhaps what has befallen us is the Divine's
ar: منهم كانوا فاسدين. أفيكون ما حلّ بنا

source_en: judgment for our failure?
Or I put my faith in with the wrong lot.
ar: فشلنا؟ أم أني وضعت إيماني في غير أهله.

source_en: I can sense it on you.
The Spire has wounded your soul.
You almost ended up like the rest of us.
I knew men more sinful than you.
They walked these halls,
belied and contrived the machinations of our fall.
ar: وخدعونا، ونسجوا مؤامرة سقوطنا. ووثقنا بهم.

source_en: We trusted them.
The wisest of us, though skeptical,
ceased once they gave us results.
I may be damned, but you have potential to save us all.
ar: قد أكون ملعونًا، لكن فيك ما ينقذنا جميعًا.

source_en: Show the Chruch that there is nothing fear from you.
ar: أرِ الكنيسة أن لا شيء فيك يُخاف.

source_en: Stop Solomon and Felwyl.
Save our realm!
I've nothing left to offer you.
ar: لم يعد لدي ما أقدمه لك.

source_en: I shall spend my eternity in great contemplation of the Divine.
ar: سأقضي أبديتي في تأمل عميق في الإله.

source_en: I've not lost my faith.
No, you've proven to me that we were misguided,
ar: بل أثبتَّ لي أننا كنا رجالًا ضالّين،

source_en: fearful men.
Once I taught that virtue was ideal.
ar: كنتُ أُعلّم يومًا أن الفضيلة هي المثال.

source_en: Like the Divine himself who took on the plight of mankind
to guide us through the darkness under his holy moonlight.
ar: الذي حمل بلاء البشر ليهدينا في الظلمات تحت ضوء قمره المقدس.

source_en: The Lunitarians feared the Nephilim.
Thus we shackled your souls and brainwashed your kind.
ar: لذا قيدنا أرواحكم وغسلنا أدمغة جنسكم.

source_en: Under the Dogma of Two Souls,
you could never be mended.
Not even if you knew the truth.
This makes you special, you see.
You can siphon the soul energy of the living.
Not only can you mend your soul,
ar: في وسعك أن تسحب طاقة الروح من الأحياء.

source_en: you can become even stronger.
Perhaps strong enough to heal the wounds
deep within your blood.
ar: بل لعلك تقوى حتى تلتئم الجروح الغائرة في دمك.

source_en: What Solomon's spire did to your soul,
broke your chains.
Now you are unstoppable.
You could leave the Order should you choose,
ar: الآن. لك أن تترك الجماعة إن شئت،

source_en: You, he who is caught between realms.
Take this opporitunity to achieve great strength.
Return to these halls,
ar: اغتنم هذه الفرصة لتنال قوةً عظيمة.

source_en: and face the foes again and again.
Those trapped in time.
Only then can you hope to stop
what has been unleashed upon Eden.
ar: عندئذٍ وحده ترجو أن توقف ما أُطلق على إيدن.

source_en: You've awakened to see the shadows on wall for what they are.
ar: لقد استيقظتَ لترى الظلال على الجدران على حقيقتها،

source_en: Yet you continue your mission.
This is the mark of a true hero.
To hell with the Order of the Crimson Moon,
and the Lunitarian faith.
You have what it means to go beyond all of us.
We attempted to control that which we should not,
ar: حاولنا أن نُخضِع ما لا ينبغي لنا،

source_en: could not, and now we suffer.
Yes its as I've suspected.
You're even stronger than before.
I earned this cell!
You hear me?!
How many souls and broken bones—worth it.
ar: كم روحٍ وكم عظمٍ مهشّم—كلها تستحق.

source_en: All of it worth it!
Had a habit of finding myself in this box.
ar: اعتدتُ أن أجد نفسي في هذا الصندوق.

source_en: Before Nachstahl Steel took over,
back when this place was owned by the Caldewels.
ar: عندما كان هذا المكان ملكاً لعائلة "كالدويل".

source_en: Ha!
Looks like you're in a bit of a bind, no?
ar: يبدو أنك في مأزق، أليس كذلك؟ عالق هناك،

source_en: Stuck out there, while I'm safe in here!
Hehehe!
Sorry friend.
Only enough room for one and my chamber pot!
ar: لا يوجد مكان إلا لشخص واحد ولقصريتي!

source_en: Hehehe!
Sometimes I see them.
The people I've killed.
I belong here.
This, this is right for me.
I guess the new owners just left me in here,
ar: يبدو أن الملّاك الجدد نسوني هنا،

source_en: and judging by the sounds of things out there,
good for me!
Safe in here, as I've always been.
I've lived here for many years!
Yes, yes would you believe it?
You've your own chains,
and I've got mine.
Learn to embrace your lot,
lean into it,
its aalll we got!
My damnation is my safety.
My soul stuck betwixt the horrors of this world
and my mind.
YOU WON'T STOP THEM.
NO ONE CAN STOP THEM.
THEY'VE ALREADY WON!
And Nephilim one last thing...
A new day is coming for the order,
and I want you by my side when it comes.
Hold onto the faith that we can fight for a better tomorrow.
ar: تمسّك بالإيمان أننا نقدر أن نقاتل من أجل غدٍ أفضل.

source_en: I’m sure you know this already, but
this is only the beginning.
ar: لكن هذه هي البداية لا غير.

source_en: Felwyl came back.
Of course he did.
And still you put him in the ground.
Nephilim, I am proud to call you my brother.
ar: أيها النيفيليم، أفخر بأن أدعوك أخي.

source_en: Now you know the burden I’ve carried for these last 300 years.
ar: الآن تعرف العبء الذي حملته طوال 300 عام.

source_en: With you, I see hope.
We will fight for a better tomorrow for our people and humanity.
ar: سنقاتل من أجل غدٍ أفضل لقومنا وللبشرية.

source_en: For now the Church has their stones.
ar: أما الآن، فقد نالت الكنيسة أحجارها،

source_en: They’ve finally gotten what they’ve wanted from the city.
ar: ونالت أخيرًا ما أرادته من المدينة.

source_en: Never mind toll in human life...
For the Order, however, our fight continues.
When you are ready for our next mission, speak with me.
And the Stone of Arcana, imprisons Aegoroth,
the Eye of the Abyss.
The First Stone is secured.
And the slaying of a Dead God?
ar: وقتلُ إلهٍ ميت؟ لا تدرك ما أنجزتَه للتو،

source_en: You have no idea what you've just accomplished, Nephilim.
ar: أيها النيفيليم. مهما جرى بعد ذلك،

source_en: Whatever happens next, do not lose faith.
May the divine guide us
Before the demons overran these streets,
ar: قبل أن يغزو الشياطين هذه الشوارع،

source_en: our soldiers held this ground.
They died for it.
The Church won't recover their tags.
They're preoccupied protecting their own interests.
So we will.
Search the field.
Bring back the Crescent Tags.
Every soldier deserves to be named.
ar: كل جندي يستحق أن يُذكر باسمه.

source_en: Before we begin,
speak with Mereda, the Order’s archivist.
See me when you’re done.
You're going to need help with your excursions.
I suggest you acquaint yourself with the hall's
Blacksmith and Merchant.
Utilize their services,
and don't hesitate to assist them
in anything they might need.
Death Knights.
Fallen warriors bound to eternity.
Bring them the end they deserve.
Excellent work Paladin! Now it's onto the...
Is everything alright? You seem... disturbed.
ar: والآن ننتقل إلى… هل كل شيء بخير؟

source_en: Is your Angel behaving strangely?
Is that voice from the Spire getting to you?
ar: أيصل إليك ذلك الصوت من البرج؟

source_en: I know what you’re going through.
But I need you focused;
ar: لكني أريدك مركّزًا؛ بقي حجرٌ واحد.

source_en: we have one Stone left.
Make that final push, and after we will talk,
I promise.
But the Church has new orders for us.
ar: لكن للكنيسة أوامر جديدة. تطالبنا أن نبحث

source_en: They demand we seek out three artifacts in the city
ar: في المدينة عن ثلاثة آثار تُسمى أحجار أبراكساس،

source_en: called Abraxas Stones,
each containing remnant souls of dead gods.
ar: حجرٍ منها بقايا أرواح آلهة ميتة.

source_en: We have two access points outside of the Soul Siphon
ar: لدينا نقطتا وصول خارج "سحب الروح" يمكننا إرسالك إليهما.

source_en: that we can send you to.
ar: عليك أن تجتاز تأثيره وتعبر المدينة من هناك.

source_en: You must brave the Siphon’s influence
and traverse the city from there.
Carve your way through this scourge and get those stones.
Divine guide your blade, Nephilim.
This invasion has spiraled beyond the empire’s
attempts at control.
Countless have lost their lives,
and among them are my Nephilim!
Grimhaven.
Demon territory.
The air itself is corrupted.
You felt it.
You've faced worse already!
ar: لقد واجهت ما هو أسوأ بالفعل!

source_en: Destroy any of those "Vessels" in your way.
ar: دمر أيًا من تلك "الأوعية" في طريقك.

source_en: I can see your angel in you more each time you return.
ar: أرى ملاكك فيك أوضح كلما عدت.

source_en: Don't be afraid of it.
That's your strength.
The Warden was built to hold things in.
Don't let it hold you back.
The Legion’s sent heavies into the streets.
ar: أرسل الفيلق وحدات ثقيلة إلى الشوارع.

source_en: Slow, armored, devastating.
Don't let them corner you.
E'frae's rot gets into you before you even feel the wound.
ar: عفن إفراي يسري فيك قبل أن تحسّ بالجرح.

source_en: You know that now.
The GildedWard.
The vampires have made it their cathedral.
Elegant.
Merciless.
Every Knight in this Order has tasted defeat.
ar: كل فارس في هذه الجماعة ذاق طعم الهزيمة.

source_en: Rise.
Get out there!
The sooner we know what's sustaining the spire's influence
ar: كلما أسرعنا في معرفة ما يُبقي نفوذ البرج قائماً،

source_en: the sooner we can reach those stones.
ar: أسرعنا في الوصول إلى تلك الأحجار.

source_en: Have I ever told you about the time I was killed
ar: أحدّثتك يومًا عن المرة التي قتلتني فيها

source_en: by an amorous vampire?
I don't want to think about what she did to this
ar: لا أريد التفكير فيما فعلته بهذا الجسد

source_en: body before the monks collected me.
There are soliders still out there, waiting to be named.
ar: ما زال في الخارج جنود ينتظرون من يردّ إليهم أسماءهم.

source_en: Have you found their tags?
These monsters have a hierarchy.
Here’s something from the top.
What you've become - the Church has no name for it.
I do.
It's called whole.
I don't recommend drinking to your victories with
the skull of your enemies.
The mead isn't worth the squeeze as it were.
ar: أعدائك. ما تجنيه لا يساوي ما تبذله.

source_en: There are foes who act as vessels of Soul Energy
ar: أعداء يعملون أوعيةً لطاقة الروح لهذا النماء الجهنّمي؟

source_en: for this Hellgrowth?
I knew this wouldn't be easy.
Its nothing your sword arm can't handle!
There's something between the paladin and Mereda.
I'd be lying if it didn't remind of when her and I
ar: وميريدا. وأكون كاذبًا إن قلت إنه لا يذكّرني بأول

source_en: had just met.
The Church will notice that transformation before long.
I'll be ready for that conversation.
I've lost more battles than you've fought.
ar: خسرتُ معارك أكثر مما خضتَ أنت.

source_en: I'm still here.
I've never seen the Undead fall in those numbers.
ar: لم أرَ الموتى الأحياء يسقطون بهذا العدد من قبل.

source_en: Keep at it.
That paladin's bond with their angel runs deeper than most.
ar: رابطة هذا الفارس المقدّس بملاكه أعمق من رابطة أكثرهم.

source_en: I've seen a hundred Nephilim.
Never quite like this.
Your angel is strong.
You are stronger.
Keep that balance.
I've seen what happens when it tips.
ar: لقد رأيت ما يحدث حين يختل.

source_en: I've stopped counting the dead,
but their names I'll never forget.
The others weren't so fortunate...
If only we’d have been informed of the risks.
If the Spire falls...
maybe then.
Maybe then we can rest.
If you’re like me,
you’ll feel better once you’ve killed something.
ar: فستشعر براحة أكبر بمجرد أن تقتل شيئًا ما.

source_en: The Egregore is not one thing.
It is many.
Stop fighting it like it is.
Right. We can get to work then.
Let's turn our attention to the War Table.
Mereda, I take no pleasure in sending my own to their deaths;
ar: ميريدا، لا أجد أي متعة في إرسال أبناء جنسي إلى حتفهم؛

source_en: our kind's release is arbitrated by the Church alone.
Nahnias fights beside you now.
Never take that loyalty for granted.
Nephilim, in death, rank means nothing.
ar: أيها النيفيليم، في الموت لا قيمة للرتبة.

source_en: These men and women gave everything.
ar: هؤلاء الرجال والنساء بذلوا كل شيء.

source_en: We'll make certain they aren't forgotten.
Well done.
Now that we know how to reach the Stones,
ar: عرفنا الآن كيف نصل إلى الأحجار،

source_en: its a matter of braving the city's perils.
ar: فلم يبق إلا اقتحام أخطار المدينة.

source_en: You've made it this far, I believe in you.
ar: بلغتَ هذا المبلغ، وأنا أثق بك.

source_en: The Undead are relentless.
Numbers don't discourage them.
The Godsreach Spire pierces Eden's veil,
destroying the fabric of our realm.
Soon it will fall...
Tyrigon is fire and fury and nothing else.
Take away its sky and it's just a beast.
ar: احرمه سماءه، فما هو إلا وحش.

source_en: That was until today,
when we saw this Spire annihilate my paladins...
ar: حين رأينا هذا البرج يسحق فرساني المقدّسين…

source_en: You're cuting through their ranks.
The Southern Ward is starting to notice.
The Southern Ward.
Undead hold every corner.
You made it further than most.
The Stone of Rot, which binds the soul of E’frae,
ar: حجر العفن، الذي يقيد روح إفراي،

source_en: the Dry Rot King.
The Stone of War, shackles the soul of Mahkteah,
the Lord of Perdition.
To charge the Spire,
ar: لاقتحام البرج، يجب أن نجد هذه الأحجار ونطرد أرواح الآلهة الميتة.

source_en: we must find these stones and banish the Dead Gods’ souls.
Then, the Spire’s barrier shall fall,
and we shall put a stop to this madness.
Your last excursion,
that is what this Order is made of.
Our lord bleeds over the cursed city.
A dire omen to be sure!
A man who reads by candlelight is half-blind.
ar: من قرأ على ضوء الشمعة فنصفُه أعمى.

source_en: A man who reads by moonlight sees what the candle hid.
ar: ومن قرأ على ضوء القمر رأى ما أخفته الشمعة.

source_en: A stag was at the cloister gate at first light.
ar: كان أيّل عند بوابة الدير مع أول الضوء.

source_en: There has not been a stag in this city in living memory.
ar: لم يُرَ أيّل في هذه المدينة في ذاكرة الأحياء.

source_en: We came to look.
The stag did not stay.
Aegoroth's stone is undone.
The Faith has its silence.
I cannot find the comfort in it.
And he so rests upon the Throne
commanding Legions of Angels in service of man's potential.
ar: يقود فيالق الملائكة في خدمة ما يقدر عليه الإنسان.

source_en: So that we may transcend the Dragon's Fire and resist the Coil...
ar: لنتسامى فوق نار التنين ونقاوم الطوق…

source_en: Another night the Sanctus is not the front line.
ar: ليلة أخرى لا يكون فيها السانكتوس خطَّ المواجهة.

source_en: We are grateful.
Be careful what you accept from the Merchant, Nephilim.
ar: احذر ما تقبله من التاجر، أيها النيفيليم.

source_en: His prices are not, as a rule, written on his receipts,
and you have been visiting often enough now
that I suspect you have begun to understand this.
ar: وقد زرتَه من المرات ما يكفي لأظنّك فطنتَ إلى ذلك.

source_en: The Angels are Lunarin's children.
But WE are Lunarin's hands.
I touched the Knight's gauntlet at vigil last night.
ar: لمستُ قفاز الفارس في سهر ليلة أمس.

source_en: By accident.
My hand has been cold since.
ar: ولم تدفأ يدي منذ ذلك الحين.

source_en: Half the books in that library are not the books
ar: نصف كتب تلك المكتبة ليست ما نقول للإيمان إنها هي.

source_en: we tell the Faith they are.
By now, Nephilim, I expect you have learned which is which.
ar: قد تعلّمت الآن أيّها من أيّ.

source_en: By the Divine,
mustn't stop until the demons are finished.
Cardinal Mathias is at rest.
We are encouraged not to speak of him.
Carry me through the dark,
lord of the light
that is not the guile sun.
The War Table is rarely free of you and the
ar: قلّما تخلو طاولة الحرب منك ومن القائد هذه الأيام،

source_en: Commander these days, Nephilim.
The other Knights wait their turn.
Some have begun to ask aloud why their turn is taking so long,
ar: وقد بدأ بعضهم يسأل جهرًا لِمَ يتأخر دوره،

source_en: and I am running out of comfortable answers.
ar: ولم يبقَ عندي من الأجوبة المريحة إلا القليل.

source_en: Cover the bread three times.
Once for the eye,
once for the hunger,
once for the thing that watches the hunger.
Egregore.
I had not had that word in my mouth before.
ar: لم ينطق لساني بهذه الكلمة من قبل.

source_en: I find I would prefer not to again.
Felwyl is dead.
The library where he taught smells of him still.
ar: ولا تزال المكتبة التي درّس فيها تفوح برائحته.

source_en: The brothers will not enter that wing.
Felwyl.
The name will not appear in the register.
ar: لن يظهر هذا الاسم في السجل.

source_en: They will not let us print it.
The Faith permits silence.
The Faith does not permit absence.
Find the line between.
The Dry Rot King is freed.
Freed to where,
I am not told.
I fear to ask.
Gajov bit a Crusader once. He bit several.
ar: عضّ قاجوف صليبيًّا يومًا. بل عضّ عددًا منهم.

source_en: We are told he stopped biting. We are told.
ar: قيل لنا إنه كفّ عن العضّ. قيل لنا.

source_en: Gajov saves his best steel for you, Nephilim,
ar: يدّخر قاجوف أجود فولاذه لك، أيها النيفيليم،

source_en: and the fact is becoming difficult to ignore.
ar: وقد بات من العسير تجاهل ذلك.

source_en: Gallant Alexander is,
by all the proper measures, a great man.
He is also the first Nephilim.
The two things must be held together.
ar: ولا بدّ من حمل الأمرين معًا.

source_en: Gallant brought the wolf-boy home.
ar: أحضر قالانت صبيّ الذئب إلى الدار.

source_en: The Faith was not consulted.
Gallant gives you missions others would refuse, Nephilim.
ar: يعطيك قالانت من المهامّ ما يرفضه غيرك،

source_en: There is a reading of this that flatters you,
and another that ought to worry you.
Gallant led the Apostate Hunts.
We do not speak of the Apostate Hunts.
Valahk-Nor frightened children once.
He frightens none tonight.
I cannot remember the name of the brother who walked beside me
ar: لا أذكر اسم الأخ الذي سار إلى جانبي في

source_en: at evening prayer last week.
He had a name.
I know it not now.
The rite of conscription was invoked on the smith
ar: أوقع قائد الفرسان طقس التجنيد على الحدّاد.

source_en: by the Knight Commander.
The Faith holds the rite is for the dying.
The smith is, technically, dying.
He has been dying for some years.
The Commander knelt in chapel last Sunday.
ar: جثا القائد في المصلّى الأحد الماضي.

source_en: He knelt for an hour, though he did not pray.
I went past the forge at the second hour of the morning.
ar: مررتُ بالحدادة في الساعة الثانية صباحًا. الحدّاد مستيقظ.

source_en: The smith was awake. The forge was cold.
He was working anyway.
The Merchant has no surname in the register.
ar: ليس للتاجر اسمُ عائلة في السجل.

source_en: I am bothered by that.
The Spire does not lean as it leant yesterday.
ar: لا يميل البرج كما مال أمس.

source_en: I am told I am imagining it.
I am told the Concordat is a kindness.
Is this truly so?
The half-bloods take communion separately.
I am told this is for our comfort.
ar: قيل لي إن ذلك من أجل راحتنا.

source_en: The Knight visits the Librarian often.
I am told this is the Order's business and not the Faith's.
ar: قيل لي إن هذا من شأن الجماعة لا من شأن الإيمان.

source_en: We prayed for E'frae's release.
I am told...
that is what we did.
I am told.
I crossed the Merchant's path at vigil last night.
ar: عبر التاجر طريقي في سهر ليلة أمس.

source_en: I will just say this. Be wary.
Something walked past the door that night.
I did not look.
I have not opened that door since.
The font was dry at vespers and full by matins.
ar: كان الجرن جافًّا عند صلاة المساء، ممتلئًا عند صلاة الفجر.

source_en: I did not refill it.
I do not call the smith, "brother".
I have not been told to.
Lotte cannot leave his chair, but his spirit can.
ar: لا يقدر لوتّه على مغادرة كرسيه، لكن روحه تقدر.

source_en: I do not know how.
I dreamt of the moon.
It was the right color.
I take what comfort I can.
I prayed for one of them this morning.
I felt watched.
The Knight asked the Commander for counsel
ar: استشار الفارس القائد ثلاث مرات هذا الأسبوع.

source_en: three times this week.
The Commander gave counsel. The counsel was sound.
I find I am not surprised by this.
The barrier is thin.
The Sanctus is colder for it.
I had not believed it could be colder.
ar: وما كنتُ أصدّق أنه يمكن أن يزداد بردًا.

source_en: Stronger again.
I had not believed stronger was something
ar: في مكانٍ ما من الغرف السفلى.

source_en: one could see across a hall.
There is new steel where the old steel was.
ar: ثمّة فولاذ جديد حيث كان القديم.

source_en: I had not noticed there was old steel.
ar: وما لاحظتُ أنّ ثمّة فولاذًا قديمًا.

source_en: Three were the wall.
I had not understood, until tonight,
that they were the wall.
The dragon.
I had not, in my life,
expected there would be a dragon.
I had not, until this morning, considered my own neck
ar: ما خطر لي، حتى هذا الصباح،

source_en: to be the most interesting feature of my person.
I had stacked those plates by weight,
then by century, then by the names on the cuffs.
ar: ثم بالقرن، ثم بالأسماء على الأكمام.

source_en: I shall stack them again.
I should very much like you to know I am
ar: وأودّ لك أن تعلم أنني أفكّر فيك وأنا أفعل،

source_en: thinking of you while I do it, Nephilim.
The Knight returned safely.
I have begun to count the times the Knight returned... different.
ar: وقد بدأتُ أعدّ المرات التي عاد فيها الفارس… غيرَه.

source_en: I have begun to hear my own prayers in another voice.
The voice does not quiet.
The second stone is here.
I have lit a candle for the Knight.
I have lit a candle for myself.
Their losses do not go in the public register.
ar: لا تُقيَّد خسائرهم في السجل العام.

source_en: They go in another book.
I have not been shown the other book.
One stone has been tithed.
There were three.
I have not slept since they told me three.
ar: وما ذقتُ النوم منذ قالوا لي ثلاثة.

source_en: The Nephilim came in this morning, and the room...
settled.
I have not the word.
The Faith is to be praised,
ar: الإيمان أهلٌ للثناء، فقد عاد الفارس.

source_en: the Knight has returned.
I have praised the Faith.
I have praised, also, the Knight.
Mereda keeps a lamp lit later than any of us.
ar: تُبقي ميريدا مصباحها موقدًا بعد مصابيحنا كلّها.

source_en: I have wondered what she reads by it.
ar: وقد تساءلتُ عمّا تقرؤه على ضوئه.

source_en: When the Knight falls,
some of us speak of mercy.
Some of judgment.
I keep my mouth where the mouth belongs.
ar: أما أنا فأبقي فمي حيث ينبغي للفم أن يكون.

source_en: The Knight buys from the Merchant often.
I know what is bought. I do not know what is paid.
ar: أعرف ما يُشترى. ولا أعرف ما يُدفع.

source_en: It is sin to fear the Knights, of course.
I observe the sin and let it sit.
I saw the Nephilim at evening prayer.
ar: رأيتُ النيفيليم في صلاة المساء. لم يكن النيفيليم في صلاة المساء.

source_en: The Nephilim was not at evening prayer.
The Nephilim was, at that hour, abroad.
I served as a novice under Gallant's command
in the last days of the Crusade.
You spend long hours with the Librarian, Nephilim.
ar: تقضي ساعاتٍ طوالًا مع أمينة المكتبة،

source_en: I would ask what she has you reading,
ar: أيها النيفيليم. وكنتُ لأسألك عمّا تُقرئك،

source_en: but you would not tell me, and she would tell me less.
ar: لولا أنك لن تخبرني، وهي أقلّ إخبارًا.

source_en: If the Faith intended my dismemberment by the Knights, Nephilim,
ar: لو أراد الإيمان أن تمزّقني الفرسان،

source_en: the Faith would have informed me.
If you must look at the moon, block it with your palm.
ar: إن لزمك النظر إلى القمر، فاحجبه بكفّك.

source_en: The Faith permits this.
It is not heresy for the Librarian to keep heretical books,
ar: ليس من الهرطقة أن تحفظ أمينة المكتبة كتبًا هرطقية،

source_en: the Faith holds, if one is keeping them safely.
ar: يقضي الإيمان، ما دامت تحفظها بأمان.

source_en: Karsivites do not worship Lunarin.
The smith is Karsivite.
Touch the doorframe before you cross it.
ar: المس إطار الباب قبل أن تعبره.

source_en: Lunarin does not enter rooms he was not invited to.
ar: لوناران لا يدخل غرفةً لم يُدعَ إليها.

source_en: Lunarin loves the half-light.
The full dark is for things that have nothing left to hide.
ar: أما الظلام التامّ فلمن لم يبقَ لديه ما يخفيه.

source_en: Mahkteah is at rest.
Mahkteah was the Lord of Perdition.
The brothers do not speak of this.
Mereda has the trust of the Order.
The Faith holds its peace with the Order.
Mereda was conscripted.
The Faith was generous with the word.
ar: وكان الإيمان سخيًّا في اختيار الكلمة.

source_en: My candles burn longer this season.
Some of them, the wick gives out before the wax.
The bells rang for the Knight's return.
They rang once more after.
No one rang the second peal.
When Cardinal Mathias was put down,
the altar of his chapter cracked.
Not from anything that was done.
Not from anything we know.
The Commander is old. Older than he looks.
ar: القائد عجوز. أكبر مما يبدو. أكبر مما يمكن أن يكون.

source_en: Older than he can be. We do not ask.
Pray as if Lunarin can hear you.
Speak as if your brother can.
When the moon is red,
the prayers must be louder.
So we are taught.
Some of the brothers say the Commander has begun
ar: يقول بعض الإخوة إن القائد بدأ يذكرك ذكر الأهل،

source_en: to speak of you as kin, Nephilim.
Some of the brothers are gossips.
Sometimes the Knight is still in the room after the Knight has left.
ar: أحيانًا يبقى الفارس في الغرفة بعد أن يغادر الفارس.

source_en: The brothers do not speak of this.
The Commander has been in this Order
for one hundred and twenty-six years.
We have done the arithmetic.
The Knight is much in the Commander's company.
The Commander treats the Knight as family.
The sin I confessed this morning is one I have not yet committed.
ar: الخطيئة التي اعترفتُ بها هذا الصباح لم أرتكبها بعد.

source_en: The Faith encourages this.
The first Dead God is undone.
The Faith has had its small mercy,
though it does not feel small.
The Faith holds, Nephilim,
that all stacked things are eventually unstacked.
The Faith is the State,
and the State is the Faith.
The man who serves one does not betray the other.
ar: ومن خدم أحدهما لم يخن الآخر.

source_en: The Knight is back.
The bells were rung. I heard the bells.
The Knight is heavier on the stone than they were last week.
ar: الفارس أثقل على الحجر مما كان الأسبوع الماضي.

source_en: The stones know.
The Merchant is hard to look at. He is not hard to see.
ar: التاجر يصعب النظر إليه. ولا يصعب أن يُرى.

source_en: We have been taught the difference.
The Merchant pays for his keep in souls.
We are told this is metaphor.
We are told this is metaphor.
The Nephilim and Librarian are much in each other's company.
ar: لا يكاد النيفيليم يفارق أمينة المكتبة.

source_en: Two who do not pray conspiring together.
We do not look at the moon directly.
We look at its reflection in the basin.
The basin's reflection is older.
The candles dim when the Knight passes the south corridor now.
ar: تخفت الشموع الآن حين يمرّ الفارس في الممر الجنوبي.

source_en: They did not used to.
Three days. Three days of sorting.
ar: ثلاثة أيام. ثلاثة أيام من الفرز.

source_en: The fourth day I was to rest.
ar: وفي الرابع كان لي أن أستريح.

source_en: The smith is loud.
The smith is always loud. The smith likes the noise.
ar: الحدّاد صاخب دائمًا. الحدّاد يحبّ الضجيج.

source_en: We see the Knight visits the smith often.
The smith is good at his work. For a wolf.
When the Nephilim passes, do not meet the visor.
ar: إذا مرّ النيفيليم، فلا تُقابل عينُك القناع.

source_en: The visor was cut deep for a reason.
ar: لم يُحفر ذلك القناع عميقًا عبثًا.

source_en: The work is not done.
The work has not been done before.
The work will be done.
There are seven nights in the calendar that have no name.
ar: في التقويم سبع ليالٍ بلا اسم.

source_en: We count them anyway.
Two of the dead are gone now.
There were three.
There is one.
They are knitted now,
somewhere in the lower chambers.
ar: في مكانٍ ما من الغرف السفلى.

source_en: We do not ask how.
They came back whole.
They did not look whole.
Though I do not know the difference.
They say the Librarian was sanctioned at Quorum.
ar: يقولون إن أمينة المكتبة عوقبت في الكوروم.

source_en: They do not say what was sanctioned.
Three faiths to keep:
in the moon, the order, and the dead.
We have noticed, Nephilim,
that the Merchant is happier on the days you visit.
ar: أن التاجر أسعدُ في الأيام التي تزوره فيها.

source_en: What am I reading?
ar: ماذا أقرأ؟ فضولي أنت على نيفيليم.

source_en: You're curious for a Nephilim.
'Tis a story about the Infernal Legion. Myth mainly.
ar: أسطورة في أغلبها. والحقّ أنه لا يُعرف عن قوى قابيل إلا القليل.

source_en: Truth be told, little is known about Cain's forces.
ar: تقول السطور: "جيش من الموتى الأحياء والشياطين ومصاصي الدماء غسل الشوارع بنهر من الدم".

source_en: This reads:
"an army of undead, demons, and vampires
washed the streets with a river of blood."
Bit melodramatic if you ask me.
As I recall Cain lost that war.
Yes, his little "Rite of Desolation". Pft.
We need more information, knight.
ar: نحتاج مزيدًا من المعلومات، أيها الفارس.

source_en: To Gildenarch with you. Make haste,
'fore all is lost.
You saw vampires?
What are they like? Do they bite?
ar: كيف هيئتهم؟ أيعضّون؟ سمعتُ أنهم متوحّشون على نحو بديع.

source_en: I hear they're gloriously feral. Is it true?
ar: أحقٌّ هذا؟ … قتلوك؟ يؤسفني ذلك جدًّا يا عزيزي.

source_en: ...Killed you? Terribly sorry dear. Sorry indeed.
ar: يؤسفني حقًّا. إن احتجتَ عونًا في أمرهم،

source_en: If you need help with them, see the Blacksmith.
You know he's one himself.
Explains his attitude.
Shall I tell you the story of the Crimson Moon?
ar: أأقصّ عليك قصة القمر القرمزي؟ نعم،

source_en: Yes, you Nephilim love this story.
Your story.
Long ago, we lived under a Golden Age.
An age that ended when fell Lord Cain
rose against the church.
ar: عصر انتهى حين ثار اللورد قابيل على الكنيسة.

source_en: Helpless and outnumbered against an army of dead,
ar: وإذ عجزت الكنيسة وغُلبت أمام جيش من الموتى،

source_en: the church made you: Nephilim.
With divine grace and angelic fury,
you razed the dead and ended Cain's crusade.
That's when it happened.
A new age born under the light of a Crimson Moon.
ar: عصر جديد وُلد تحت ضوء قمر قرمزي.
